## Learner-visible change

Describe what changes for learners or contributors and link the approved Issue.

## Publication Pair

- [ ] Chinese and English counterparts are both complete, aligned, and directly linked, or this change introduces no learner-facing content.
- [ ] Navigation exposes only complete material.
- [ ] Canonical English terms appear on first Chinese use.

## Source and license review

- [ ] Version-sensitive interfaces were checked against current Context7 where available and exact owner sources.
- [ ] New or adapted material records the exact source, release, file license, attribution, notices, and modifications.
- [ ] File-level Apache-2.0, CC BY 4.0, and upstream terms remain correct.
- [ ] Maintainer-only material, private paths, credentials, and secrets are absent from source and artifacts.

## Evidence Status impact

- [ ] This change does not infer Compile-Checked or a runtime Evidence Status from web CI.
- [ ] Any compilation, community, runtime, pending, or not-applicable claim links to its actual evidence.
- [ ] Expected observations remain separate from recorded observations.

## Accessibility and verification

- [ ] Keyboard, focus, zoom/reflow, forced colors, reduced motion, mobile, print, and textual equivalents were checked as applicable.
- [ ] `npm run build:release` passes.
- [ ] Applicable browser and visual checks pass.

## Residual boundary

List any external blocker, unsupported environment, hardware gap, or follow-up Ticket. A blocker grants no evidence status.
